intent: Immutable declaration of one transfer evaluation run: artifact hashes, the component-102-owned shared request contract snapshot, partitions, settings, comparison joins, thresholds, and execution metadata.

shared_request_contract.intent: Freeze the production request identity both target adapters consume. Production prompt text is referenced and hashed, never copied into evaluation artifacts.
shared_request_contract.budget_source_note: Source-based parity (integration control-plane record R13 and directive R14): the effective budget is the literal max_tokens: 1200 and the thinking flag is enable_thinking: false at the transfer call site in the production Edge Function, not a shared export. A 102-owned exported constant is the documented alternative.

partitions.intent: Declared partitions with case versions, exposure status, and denominator rules.

settings.intent: Frozen execution settings. The transfer target path declares its own budget and thinking flag instead of inheriting the legacy v1 values.

legacy_v1_path.note: The legacy v1 evaluation path continues to use evals/promptfoo/v1/settings.json unchanged (target_max_tokens 8000, target_enable_thinking true). That path evaluates a different production call and is not the transfer parity claim.

comparison.intent: Baseline and candidate joins and the permitted changed experimental factors.

thresholds.intent: Frozen thresholds and blocking behaviour copied from gate-policy.json at manifest freeze time.

execution.intent: Commands, revision, worktree state, and timing for one immutable run.

rules: Freeze the manifest before candidate evaluation and holdout exposure.
A case, rubric, adapter, contract, setting, threshold, or gate change creates a new manifest version and a new comparable baseline.
A shared-builder hash, production-prompt hash, budget, thinking-flag, or parity mismatch makes the run incomplete before semantic scoring.
Interrupted runs are preserved as partial evidence and never reported as accepted.

pre_scoring_blockers: missing shared_request_contract or any of its required fields
builder_source_sha256 not equal to the hash of the production source file on disk
production_prompt_source_sha256 not equal to the hash of the production Edge Function on disk
either effective completion-token budget other than 1200
either effective enable_thinking value not equal to the frozen value
any evaluator-only metadata, copied production prompt text, or credential in target evidence
